name: render-harness
description: A Render-native agent harness. Built on Render primitives (Workflows, Workers, Cron, Postgres, KV, Private Services), provider-agnostic at the model layer, MCP-first for tools.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter='./packages/*' run build && pnpm -r --filter='./examples/*' run build
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U harness -d harness
scripts.apps:operator-demo: pnpm -r --filter='./packages/*' --filter='@render-harness/example-operator-demo' run build && docker compose --profile operator-demo up -d --wait
scripts.apps:operator-demo:reload: pnpm -r --filter='./packages/*' --filter='@render-harness/example-operator-demo' run build && docker compose --profile operator-demo up -d operator-demo-web operator-demo-worker && docker compose --profile operator-demo restart operator-demo-web operator-demo-worker
